svg.title: Zip-tie station 1 position
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with plug length set to 40 and zip-tie station placement set to Manual, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: zip-tie station 1 position at 27 mm: slides the rear zip-tie station along each arm, measured from the cord end. Marked in red: 1, the zip stations: the three small holes along each arm.
